meta.title: Jingshu phone host

description:
Connects the Jingshu mobile app to DSH on this computer. The plugin installs and supervises the host-side bridge (relay, credentials, reverse calls, outbox).

Where the login code is: sidebar More -> Jingshu Pairing. The panel shows a QR code and a 6-digit login code. Codes are single-use and valid for 10 minutes; the panel rotates them automatically.

If the phone keeps disconnecting: just restart DSH. The plugin restarts the bridge by itself; no scripts needed.
